listing.title: VeloRix Tournaments
listing.short_description: Compete in esports tournaments, track live matches, and climb leaderboards.
listing.full_description:
VeloRix Tournaments is an esports competition and tournament management platform designed for competitive mobile gamers. Join solo, duo, and squad matches, track match status, verify in-game IDs, and compete for top ranks on the Hall of Champions leaderboard.

FEATURES GROUNDED IN APP CAPABILITIES:

• TOURNAMENTS & MATCHMAKING: Browse upcoming, ongoing, and completed tournaments across multiple formats (Solo, Duo, Squad). View live entry fees, verified prize pools, slots progression, and lobby countdown timers.

• TOURNAMENT LOBBY & DETAILS: Review comprehensive match rules, map specifications, prize distribution tiers, and participate in tournament lobby communication.

• PLAYER PROFILES & UID VALIDATION: Connect and validate your official Free Fire and BGMI player UID (8-12 numeric digits) with instant verification feedback. Showcase win rates, match counts, and generate your personal QR player pass.

• HALL OF CHAMPIONS: Track top-tier players and squads on weekly and all-time leaderboards with podium rankings.

• VELORIX VAULT & ESCROW: Manage your tournament entries with in-app tokens (VT), view transaction history, and generate UPI payment requests.

• HIGH-PERFORMANCE LIQUID UI: Experience hardware-accelerated animations, customizable Liquid Glass effects, dark theme styling, and instant screen switching powered by memory-optimized lazy loading and shimmer skeletons.

• CUSTOMER SUPPORT: In-app support ticket submission and live communication system to resolve match discrepancies and tournament queries.

COMPLIANCE & RESPONSIBLE GAMING DISCLOSURES:

• 18+ AGE RESTRICTION: VeloRix Tournaments is strictly intended for individuals who are 18 years of age or older. Age verification is required during account registration.

• JURISDICTION RESTRICTION: Real-money skill gaming contests are restricted and prohibited for residents of Assam, Odisha, Telangana, Nagaland, Sikkim, and Andhra Pradesh in accordance with local regulations.

• RESPONSIBLE GAMING HELPLINE: We advocate for responsible competition. If you need assistance with responsible gaming habits, please reach out to the National Gaming Support helpline or email support@velorix.gg.

• COMMUNITY GUIDELINES: Toxicity, unfair third-party hacks, and cheating are strictly prohibited. Violators are subject to account suspension under our Fair Play & Security policy.
